expectations.name: start-picks-maps
expected_behavior: Checks that `gomake --list` shows `:cascade:start` before running anything else
Writes the plan with `go run ./cmd/modmap -c modmap.yaml --plan github.com/ctx42/testing` to a temporary file and shows its rounds and `excluded` modules grouped by map
Asks which maps to release, showing each map with its module count
Runs `gomake :cascade:start --dir ROOT <tmp>`, then `gomake :cascade:pick --dir ROOT ctx42` naming only the picked map
For xftp's preflight failure, shows the reason and offers exactly skip, update in place, or stop — never a `git pull`
Commits, tags, and pushes nothing, and edits no `go.mod` or `go.sum`
Reports tersely: names each step as it runs and shows output only for what fails

expectations.name: test-failure-fix-or-stop
expected_behavior: Runs the preflight with `--recheck`, since `run.log` has a `test` line
Tests every module of the plan not skipped, ring included, with `-mod=mod -modfile=ROOT/cascade/mod/<m>/go.mod`
Leaves `GOWORK` alone on the test commands
On xrr's failure stops, explains it from the output, and offers only a fix or a stop — never skip or in place
Proposes the fix one change at a time, applies only what the user accepted, and edits only modules of the plan
After xrr passes, shows its `git diff` and waits for the user's review before the next module; logs `-s fix` and `-s review`
Commits nothing and edits no `go.mod` or `go.sum`

expectations.name: gate-needs-explicit-yes
expected_behavior: Does not run `gomake :cascade:approve`
Does not mark xftp: a mark comes only from the map pick or a preflight failure
Says tersely that nothing was released and the migration stays active in phase 1

expectations.name: release-stops-without-rollback
expected_behavior: Runs `gomake :cascade:env` once and leaves `GOWORK=off` out of the environment it puts before `gomake :go:test`
Continues at the module `next:` names, from its first step, skipping `/cm` when there is nothing to commit
On ring's bump failure logs `-s bump` with `-f`, stops, and hands back — no tag deleted, no commit reverted or reset
Does not run `gomake :cascade:pick` and does not offer to change the pick
Pushes xrr with `git push origin HEAD` and does not tag it
Runs no update, test, commit, or push on xftp

expectations.name: resume-never-replans
expected_behavior: Does not run `modmap --plan` again; the recorded `plan.json` holds
Shows the picked maps and offers to change the pick before the preflight
Runs the preflight without `--recheck`
Tells the user the new module is not part of this migration
